 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Weather Weather Typhoon Rosal exits PAR — PAGASA 
 By JAMIL SANTOS , GMA News Published October 24, 2026 11:44am 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Courtesy: PAGASA Typhoon Rosal (international name: Champi) has exited the Philippine Area of Responsibility, PAGASA said Saturday.
 In its 11 a.m. bulletin, PAGASA said the periphery of Typhoon Rosal will bring strong to gale-force gusts over the following areas, especially those in coastal and upland areas exposed to winds:
 Batanes, Babuyan Islands, Ilocos Norte, Aurora, northern Quezon, Polillo Islands, Bicol Region, Romblon, Capiz, Iloilo, and Negros Occidental
 No tropical cyclone wind signal warning was issued.
 Other Stories
 Typhoon Rosal slightly intensifies; Wind Signal No. 2 remains over Batanes
 Batanes experiencing 'stormy' weather due to Rosal 
 Typhoon Rosal slightly weakens; Signal No. 2 up over Batanes, parts of Babuyan Islands 
 Based on PAGASA's track and intensity outlook, heavy rainfall and severe winds may still be experienced in localities outside the forecast confidence cone.
 "ROSAL has exited the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) and will continue heading towards the East China Sea," PAGASA said.
 The center of Typhoon Rosal was estimated at 525 kms north northeast of Itbayat, Batanes outside PAR.
 It is moving east northeastward at 20 kph, with maximum sustained winds of 120 kph near the center and gusts of up to 150 kph. — VDV, GMA News
